steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: And this is your glass.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Thank you. Thank you.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: The Roar Guards Company offers a wealth of beverages to its members. I truly envy them. They possess the luxury of standing here and observing each knight's magnificent display.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Tell me. You are a good person, correct?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Have you broken the law before?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Have you ever committed a wrongdoing?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: No, of course not, never...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: So in other words, you are a diligent worker who earns his pay for himself and his family. Doesn't that make you a good person?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Y-Yes, if you put it that way, I'd definitely be a good person, a good person like so many others in Kazimierz...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Indeed, so many others. Here. Let us toast to the good people.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ah. Cheers.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Tell me. If there were some who sought to deprive good people of their work, to deprive good people of their way of life, could those possibly be good people, now?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: What do you...?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Even the countryside farmers, done tending their fields for the day, will look forward to that competition knight broadcast from the city.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: For hundreds of thousands... possibly millions of Kazimierz's industrial people, the Major is a part of life. And they are all good people, by and large, my friend.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: So, you mean...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Suppose, one day, the Major was gone... that overnight, the business had vanished.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: Who would now support our campaign knights' expenditures, which grow annum by annum? Who would vie for Kazimierz's economic standing, and so stave off foreign incursions?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: My friend, tell me. Are those who would see that happen—bad people?

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: You are a good person, and they would deprive you of your own living to crown their ancient sense of 'honor.'

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: We all rely on others to pave the way. We've given the vast majority—even the Infected—the chance to live...

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: And so those 'bad people' would ignore that, their country and all its citizens, for their own inconsequential, self-centered consolation.

steps.name: Spokesman Czarny
steps.text: My friend. You are a good person, correct?

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: This place is Nearl's regular bar, right? Whoo-wee, now this is what I call Kazimierzey!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Hey, Boss! Think Maria Nearl might come here today?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: That's down to your own square luck.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Business been good lately?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Thanks to Maria.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: When's the last time we got so many in here? Back with Zofia?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Knight's the magic word. Most people're here just for that. Don't even ask me which of the media monkeys said it...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Not happy even for the money?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Wasn't the idea to give the two of them somewhere nice and quiet to relax?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hey, Marcin. Think about carving it into this seat here, 'Kowal ONLY.' Don't wanna wait for a spot next time I come by.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Cough up a naming fee and I'll agree.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Whoa, whoa, Nearl's really here! It's literally her!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Quick! Don't let the chance slide, go get a picture!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Er, thanks, thanks... picture? You mean me? Sorry, I'm a little...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Alright, alright, make way, you lot—

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Hold on... you're Zofia! The 'Whislash' Zofia!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Hey, the rumors were true! 'Whislash' Zofia is the actual coach of the new Nearl!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Miss Zofia! I've watched your matches before! They really shook me!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: (Oh, well, we're done for.)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (A-Auntie! Think of something, quick!)

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Maria, I love you!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: What did you just say?!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hey, take your fights outside.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: You've gotta be at least this old to brawl in here.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —Mister Kowal! Mister Vogelweide!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: All customers, listen up! To celebrate our two old regulars and their outstanding performance, prices today are all 20% off!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Everybody sit down and get your orders ready! All drinks and snacks are limited supplies only! Once we're out, we're out!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Discounts? Could it get any better?

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Hold on... hold on... the bald guy there, you think he's...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Just old Marcin, nothing more. Go on. What's your business?

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Marcin...? You're the real 'Tremoriron' Marcin... *sobbing*... Today's just too blessed... Give me a 'Marcin Special'...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: F... finally... I've never seen this place so lively before...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Bless your heart, Marcin. I'll help you recoup the costs later.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Hah hah hah. If you think 20% off'll sink my bar, you'd be selling old Marcin short.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Crafty hand, you.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: W-What? Can I keep drinking or not?!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Place's empty, old boy. Who're you even drinking with?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I—*geurgh*—

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Don't throw up here—do it outsi—God! Your old damned bones!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Let's get down to business, then. Closing hours and all.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Closing hours are where we're booked in, hm?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Hah hah hah, they're when this little bar's really open for service.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria... you've gotten enough points already.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: You've been winning fight after fight. It's incredible.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Th... there's been an element of luck to it...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: As long as you can maintain the score, dig your heels in on it until the end of the season, that'll be the best plan... But I'm worried about something else.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Auntie?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Maria, the next match is a race. Races don't make for great changes in points, so it should be a safe bet.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: And then after that, don't participate in any more matches.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Wha?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: B... but, just staying...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You've done plenty enough. Victory's at hand now.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Surely you've noticed it too... Maria, a lot of people are paying attention to you right now.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: We just need to keep the pace. Wait until the points are finalized, and you'll win a knight's title, and we'll have achieved our goal.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Okay? Just listen to your sister. This will all be for the best—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But this... this isn't going to change anything at all... If I don't keep going, the Nearl family's still going to be stuck in this position...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uncle Młynar wouldn't approve of doing things this way, either...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Młynar? He's like talking to a brick wall! He wouldn't approve no matter what you decided to do. You know that better than anyone, don't you?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Just don't think about it too much, okay? Maria... this is all for the best. It's this or nothing.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Auntie... what happened?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You don't know how deep the Major really goes... You don't know what it is you'll be up against at all...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Auntie!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...In the arena, victory will never belong to a knight. Victory will only ever belong to Kazimierz, belong to... to the corporations.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: If you truly don't want to work with them, you shouldn't have joined the Major in the first place. If we keep doing things your way... Maria, we need to know where to stop.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Zofia. What did you find out?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...That Słoma employee I know told me about some rumblings. Maria's popularity has thrown her into the Knights Association's executive sights far sooner than anyone else...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: If Maria doesn't stop where she should, they'll start making moves! No matter what it is they're planning for us, we don't have to grin and bear any of it!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: So, Maria, listen to your sister, okay?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I... I don't get it... If we don't want to be controlled by them, we have to bow to them? Where's the difference?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria! This is no joking matter—!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I know—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You could die in the arena!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...'Flametail' said so too. I haven't seen what the significance of the Major really is...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I know I might genuinely have no idea what cruelties she was referring to... but I didn't enter the tournament for fun, either!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I don't care about injuries, I don't care about accidents, I don't even care if I have to sacrifice—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That's enough!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah... I'm really sorry, Auntie, I didn't mean...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That's not a 'sacrifice' at all. And I don't want to watch you suffer for any of this, either...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I see how you're thinking. You really need to learn when enough is enough!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...I don't think I should stop here.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Even if I don't pass the qualifiers, even if I fall short of my goal, I should be fighting for my own cause... I should be striving to win until I can't win anymore!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Alright, I get it.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Auntie...!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I'm convinced you should stop. You don't understand the Major. You can't understand... the sheer outrage Margaret's actions caused back then.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: If Kazimierz really was a fair country, everything you've said could be true. But that's not how it goes. Any idiot can see how flimsy all our rules are, and how trivial it is to leave them in pieces.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You're still an untitled, unaffiliated, independent knight, Maria. I can apply to the Knights Association for a suspension on your tournament campaign.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: So there.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Auntie!

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Cool down, Maria. And let Zofia cool down a little too.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: She means you well.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: But Zofia's right. A knight doesn't win the Major by will alone.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: The corps were only interested in giving 'the new Nearl knight' the chance to take root and start growing. When they decide to reap you, they'll come out with their sickles, no second thoughts.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Knights get one right, and it's to apply to the events... beyond the Major, corps have every rank and result in vice grips. Knights don't get a choice any way or how.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: If Zofia's heard the truth, and the company insiders are making noise...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Maybe we should be picking up on the signals. Paying attention, at least.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Weugh... whassappenin'? Swear I saw Zofia storming out just now...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: What's the long face for, girl? Didn'tcha win? What's to argue after winning?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: You two, stop making it worse...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...I-I'm going home.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I have a race coming up, and I still need to do my equipment maintenance...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (She's beautiful, but she carries the scent of blood... is she a knight?)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (Maria Nearl. Young... even younger than she looked in the material.)

steps.name: Maria & Platinum
steps.text: (Shame.)
